text: Papa? How do you talk to God? Do I need big church words?
Nope. Praying is just talking to God. Same way you talk to me.
Especially in your pajamas. Here's a trick. Hold up three fingers.
One, thank Him. Two, tell Him what's in your heart. Three, ask Him for help.
Okay. Dear God, thank You for Papa.
I got scared of the dark today. Please help me be brave.
See? God heard every word. The Bible says, never stop praying.
